name: Do I need architectural plans before contacting Hometelligent Inc. for an addition?

mainEntity.name: Do I need architectural plans before contacting Hometelligent Inc. for an addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: While having preliminary ideas or sketches is helpful, you don't necessarily need fully developed architectural plans before contacting us. We can guide you through the initial design phase, helping translate your vision into actionable blueprints. Our process typically starts with a consultation to understand your needs and then moves to conceptual design with our network of architects and designers. This ensures the plans align with both your goals and our construction expertise from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, you don't need full architectural plans. We can help guide you through the design phase after an initial consultation.
